metadata.title: Public Water Main
metadata.description: Water main assets owned and operated by the City of Calgary for the distribution of drinking water.

scope.method: Source geometries intersect original official community polygons. Boundary-crossing assets can belong to multiple communities.

schema.label: LENGTH
schema.description: length of water main in m

schema.label: DIAM
schema.description: diameter of water main in mm

metadata.outputFormat: GeoJSON FeatureCollection; original geometry field moved to feature.geometry; source number columns converted from numeric strings to JSON numbers.

observedPeriod.meaning: Recorded installation years, not inspection/condition dates.

limits: Installation age and material do not establish remaining useful life or a replacement schedule.
Public infrastructure is distinct from privately owned service lines/interior plumbing.
